orientation_check.method: LDEM_75S_240M (bilinear) vs global LDEM_64 (nearest) at 4 latitudes x 120 longitudes
orientation_check.verdict: forward equations (90E to the right of the pole) confirmed

site_terrain_20m.window: 101 x 101 px (2.02 km) centred on site

horizon_search.method: Ray march on LDEM_75S_240M from the site at 240 m steps; stop when terrain at the global maximum height (LDEM_64 label MAXIMUM, +100 m margin) at that distance would lie below the running horizon (elevation of a fixed-height point decreases monotonically with distance). Lunar curvature enters once, via exact sphere geometry.
horizon_search.caveat: coarse_horizon values are a 240 m diagnostic for coverage planning, NOT a validated horizon
